title: Morning rush in San Diego: every bus, train and ferry, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in San Diego, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus, train and ferry inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the San Diego city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Bus, Rapid, Trolley and Ferry.

Busiest moment of the morning: 257 vehicles at 7:53 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).
